$comment: The assumptions of the cost estimate (scripts/cost/estimate.mjs, docs/cost.md). basis says where each value comes from: measured (a run of one of this repository's commands, named in source), derived (computed from measured values or from the code, as source says), template (the synthesized templates of the prod stage), documented (AWS documentation) or assumed (a choice of the estimate, not measured). Per invoice unless the unit says otherwise.

hoursPerMonth.source: The month of the AWS pricing examples.

auroraInstances.source: A writer and a reader of promotion tier 1 that scales with the writer, so both run the same capacity (infra/cdk/lib/stage.ts, reader: true; lib/database-stack.ts, scaleWithWriter).

auroraMinAcu.source: minCapacity of the prod stage (infra/cdk/lib/stage.ts); maxCapacity is 4.

auroraBaseGb.source: The schema, the reference data and their indexes before any invoice.

dbPermanentBytes.source: The demo database (make demo): average row length times rows per document of documents, lines, taxes, withholdings, timeline, files, delivery attempts and payments, 11.2 KB, with as much again for their indexes. Kept for good.

dbWebhookEventBytes.source: Average row length of webhook_events in the demo database; kept 30 days (backend/config/retention.php).

dbOutboxEventBytes.source: Average row length of outbox_events in the demo database; kept 7 days.

dbTransmissionBytes.source: Average row length of dian_transmissions in the demo database; kept 180 days.

dbWriteIos.source: make cloud-check: the MySQL counters Com_insert, Com_update and Com_delete grew by 4,121 for 47 documents, each statement counted as one write I/O of Aurora. An upper bound: the check also rotates identities and deletes its companies.

dbReadIos.source: make cloud-check: Innodb_buffer_pool_reads did not grow, so the working set stayed in memory.

natGateways.source: natGateways of the prod stage, in the first zone, with one Elastic IP.

interfaceEndpointServices.source: email, kms, secretsmanager, sns and sqs: backend/resources/aws/services.json without s3 and dynamodb, which have gateway endpoints. Off in the prod stage; the levers turn them on.

kmsKeys.source: The keys of the signing certificates, the database and the alarm topics, with automatic rotation, priced in their first year.

secrets.source: The application, the edge, the chat webhook and the two database identities.

wafRules.source: Three AWS managed rule groups and two rate-based rules in one web ACL.

alarmMetrics.source: 16 alarms; the three of metric math count 8, 8 and 2 metrics.

customMetrics.source: 14 metric names from the metric filters; ChainStepDuration has one metric per job of the chain, 7.

logRetentionMonths.source: Every log group of the prod stage keeps its logs 365 days.

imageGb.source: The image of the functions compressed in ECR, counted whole for each image kept (no layer shared): the local image is 323 MB uncompressed.

memoryApi.source: memorySize of the api function (infra/functions/serverless.yml); chain has 1 GB too.

memoryRelay.source: memorySize of the relay and scheduler functions.

schedulesPerMinute.source: The relay and the scheduler, each rate(1 minute).

topicPublishers.source: The six functions of the application, each with a role of its own, which publish to the topic of document events.

originVerifierCalls.source: API Gateway keeps the authorizer's response 300 s (the template): one call per 5 minutes.

outboxEvents.source: make cloud-check: 360 outbox events for 30 invoices (step 6), 493 for 41 (step 9).

chainMessages.source: make cloud-check: 288 events routed to the chain queue for 41 invoices; 336 chain jobs for 47 documents in the logs.

webhookEvents.source: make cloud-check: 123 webhook events for 41 invoices (issued, accepted, delivered).

objects.source: make cloud-check: 205 objects in the bucket for 41 invoices (signed XML, DIAN response, AttachedDocument, PDF and zip).

emails.source: make cloud-check: 41 emails through SES for 41 invoices.

documentBytes.source: The 60 invoices of the demo in backend/storage/app/documents on average: signed XML 18,371, response 4,649, AttachedDocument 31,109, PDF 44,268 and zip 45,921 bytes. Each object is under 128 KB, so the lifecycle rules leave it in S3 Standard (objects that small do not transition by default).

pdfBytes.source: The average PDF of the demo's invoices.

zipBytes.source: The average zip of the demo's invoices, the email's attachment.

invoiceJsonBytes.source: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id} of an accepted demo invoice.

webhookBodyBytes.source: The local webhook receiver's last 200 webhooks: invoice.issued 7,018, invoice.accepted 9,060 and invoice.delivered 10,873 bytes on average.

logBytes.source: make cloud-check: the journey of one invoice in the emulator's CloudWatch Logs, 33 JSON lines (api 1,403, chain 8,082, webhooks 5,154 bytes).

relayLogBytesPerRun.source: make cloud-check: 3,111 bytes in 3 runs of the relay.

schedulerLogBytesPerRun.source: make cloud-check: 3,586 bytes in 3 runs of the scheduler.

platformLogBytes.source: The JSON system lines of Lambda at INFO (start and report); the emulator writes none.

chainJobMs.source: About ten times the emulator's median, 35.5 ms: a function of 1 GB gets part of a vCPU (one vCPU at 1,769 MB).

dianWaitMs.source: The transmission's wait for the DIAN's response; the local simulator responds in a median of 69 ms, and the real service was never called.

webhookJobMs.source: The emulator's median is 19.2 ms; a delivery also waits for the customer's endpoint.

relayRunMs.source: The emulator's medians are 76 ms for the relay and 88 ms for the scheduler.

originVerifierMs.source: A comparison of two strings and, cold, one read of a secret.

coldStartShare.source: One in a hundred invocations starts a new execution environment.

initMs.source: The emulator's cold start of the API is 0.86 s through the edge; AWS bills the initialization of every function.

secretReadsPerColdStart.source: The application's secret and the secret of the function's database identity, read when the function starts (LoadSecrets).

apiRequests.source: An integration creates the draft, issues it, reads it back and downloads the PDF.

webSessions.source: One session of the web app per 50 invoices.

webRequestsPerSession.source: Half of them files of the web app, half calls to the API.

webApiRequestsPerSession.source: The calls to the API of one session.

webBytesPerSession.source: The production build's files and the API's responses of one session.

webhookSubscriptions.source: One webhook endpoint per company, subscribed to every event.

southAmericaShare.source: Every viewer is in Colombia and reaches an edge location of South America, which PriceClass_All includes.

dianBytes.source: The SOAP request with the zipped signed XML in base64, and its response, through the NAT gateway.

sesBytes.source: The email with its zip in base64, sent to the SES API through the NAT gateway.

snsBytesPerEvent.source: One publish to SNS through the NAT gateway.

sqsRequestsPerMessage.source: SNS sends the message, and Lambda receives and deletes it, one message per batch at these rates.

sqsIdleRequests.source: Lambda long-polls each queue while it is empty; counted as five pollers on each of the two queues, one receive every 20 s each.

s3Gets.source: The chain reads its files back to sign, to send, to build the AttachedDocument and to email them, and the integration downloads two.

kmsRequests.source: Two signatures, each decrypting the data key of the certificate (backend/app/Support/Keys/KmsKeyStore.php).

dynamoWritesPerRequest.source: The rate limit's counter in the limits table.

dynamoReadsPerRequest.source: The rate limit's counter, read back.

dynamoSchedulerWritesPerMinute.source: The scheduler's locks and heartbeat in the cache table.

flowLogBytes.source: The VPC flow log records of one invoice's connections.

flowLogBytesIdle.source: The flow log records of the relay's and the scheduler's runs.

databaseLogBytesIdle.source: The error, slow query and audit logs (connections and changes of users and schema) exported to CloudWatch Logs.

firewallLogBytesIdle.source: AWS WAF logs only the requests it blocks or counts.

edgeLogBytesPerRequest.source: One line of CloudFront's standard logs in S3, kept 365 days.
